title: RTL text odt 001
notes: real RTL fixture: named paragraph style GP RTL (style:paragraph-properties fo:text-align="end" + style:text-properties fo:direction="rtl"); three Arabic sentences as GP RTL paragraphs. Honest caveats: ODF has no dedicated paragraph-bidi attribute, so direction rides on fo:direction on the style text-properties and end-alignment via fo:text-align="end" (mirror logic left-to-right renderers differ on); embedded LTR/bidi reordering is performed by the renderer's bidi engine, not stored as layout. No normative ODF counter matches; feature counts stay 0.
